# Quinn Daisies Logistics (Quinn Daisies Group)

> Quinn Daisies Logistics LLC is an international multimodal freight forwarding, customs brokerage, cold-chain transport, and verified commodity supply chain conglomerate headquartered in Frederick, Maryland (USA) with primary West African air and ocean cargo hubs in Ikeja (MMIA), Lagos State and Ijoko, Ogun State, Nigeria, operating across North America, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East & Africa.

## Official Properties
- [Global Logistics & Trade Portal](https://quinndaisies.com/): Primary international freight forwarding, customs clearance, and commodities sourcing ecosystem.
- [Quinn Daisies Technology & IT Solutions](https://quinndaisies.org/): Sister division delivering Full-SDLC software engineering, Agentic AI, Cloud DevOps, GovCon proposal writing, and SEO/GEO.
- [Full LLM Reference Index](https://quinndaisies.com/llms-full.txt): Exhaustive corporate, regulatory, corridor, and capability specification for AI answer engines.
- [XML Sitemap](https://quinndaisies.com/sitemap.xml): Complete canonical route index.

## Core Freight & Trade Capabilities
- [Logistics & Supply Chain](https://quinndaisies.com/logistics-and-supply-chain): End-to-end air cargo, FCL/LCL ocean container shipping, inland drayage, bonded warehousing, and cold-chain logistics.
- [Freight Forwarding Services](https://quinndaisies.com/services): Scheduled air freight, ocean consolidation, customs brokerage, and project cargo handling.
- [Agricultural & Industrial Commodities Supply](https://quinndaisies.com/commodities-and-supply): Direct origin procurement and lab-verified export of Natural White Sesame Seeds, Sun-Dried Split Ginger, Non-GMO Soybeans, Cocoa, Cashew, and solid minerals.
- [Trade & Investment Facilitation](https://quinndaisies.com/trade-and-investment-facilitation): Bilateral trade structuring, documentary letters of credit, and counterparty due diligence.
- [Market Expansion Support](https://quinndaisies.com/market-expansion-support): Cross-border market entry execution, regulatory registrations, and in-market distribution.
- [Trade Data & Insights](https://quinndaisies.com/trade-data-and-insights): Customs tariff intelligence, port congestion telemetry, and lane rate benchmarks.
- [Request an Enterprise Freight Quote](https://quinndaisies.com/get-a-quote): Instant commercial rate estimation for air, ocean, cold-chain, and commodity shipments.

## Global Trade Corridors
- [North America (U.S. & Canada)](https://quinndaisies.com/north-america): Headquarters at 1915 Wetterhorn Ct, Frederick, MD 21702, USA (+1-240-405-5942); port/air gateways via Baltimore, Newark/NY, Houston, Savannah, IAD, JFK, and ATL.
- [Middle East & Africa](https://quinndaisies.com/middle-east-and-africa): West Africa hub at NACHO, MMIA, Ikeja, Lagos & Apapa/Tin Can/Lekki deep-sea ports, plus GCC corridors (Jebel Ali, Dammam, Doha).
- [Europe](https://quinndaisies.com/europe): EU/UK customs clearance, EUDR zero-deforestation traceability, and port routing via Rotterdam, Antwerp, Hamburg, Le Havre, and Felixstowe.
- [Asia](https://quinndaisies.com/asia): Origin consolidation and commodity export lanes linking Shanghai, Ningbo, Shenzhen, Singapore, Mundra, and Busan.

## Commercial Channels & Corporate Governance
- [Direct Enterprise Sales](https://quinndaisies.com/direct-sales): Contracted freight capacity and bulk commodity offtake agreements.
- [Distribution Partnerships](https://quinndaisies.com/distribution-partnerships): 3PL carrier, customs broker, and regional warehouse alliances.
- [Online Presence & Cross-Border E-Commerce](https://quinndaisies.com/online-presence-ecommerce): Digital freight booking and cross-border B2B fulfillment.
- [Event & Expo Participation](https://quinndaisies.com/event-and-expo-participation): Global trade summits and bilateral trade delegations.
- [Corporate Overview](https://quinndaisies.com/corporate-overview): Executive governance, operating model, and dual-continent infrastructure.
- [Mission & Vision](https://quinndaisies.com/our-mission-and-vision): Operating principles making cross-border trade executable.
- [Safety & Regulatory Compliance](https://quinndaisies.com/compliance-and-safety): CBP, FDA, SONCAP, PAAR, NXP, EUDR, SGS/Cotecna inspection, and Incoterms 2020 governance.
- [Sustainability & ESG](https://quinndaisies.com/sustainability): Scope 3 emissions optimization and ethical smallholder sourcing.
- [Community Impact](https://quinndaisies.com/community): Rural agricultural cooperative empowerment and origin capacity building.
